headline:
What actually sits behind
an index token?

columns.title: A price promise
columns.text: A contract pays the index return. You rely on whoever writes it.

columns.title: An IOU
columns.text: Someone else holds the basket and issues you a claim on it.

columns.title: The assets themselves
columns.text: The token holds every component on chain. Redeem and you can take them.

bar: Xindex index tokens are backed in kind.
